Metropolitan Government of Nashville & Davidson County Amendment of Contract #15182 between Metro and Don Stoughton and Associates, Inc. Contract Amendment Documents Attached: 1, Amendment Summary Form & Signature Page.
2. E-mail between Finance Director David Manning & Finance Officer (Purchasing) Stan Melton indicating funding source is CJC (Criminal Justice Center) Capital Appropriation.
3. Current Certificate of Insurance indicating one million dollars of professional liability insurance expiring January 20, 2006.
4. Task Order No. One indicating services to be rendered.
5. Task Order No. Two indicating services to be rendered.
6. Copy of original contract #15182. Section 5 of this contract currently reads “The total value of this contract is $2,500,000.00” which is hereby being amended to read “The total value of this contract is $2,750,000.00”. Any questions concerning this amendment should be directed to Mr. David Manning, Director of Finance or Mr. Stan Melton in Metro Purchasing. ARCHIVE

This document and its attachments constitute a TIME & MATERIALS TASK ORDER issued in accordance with the terms and conditions of an amendment number #1 of Contract Number _L-245__ between Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County (Metro) and Don Stoughton and Associates, Inc. (DSA) and is subject to all applicable provisions of said contract except as specifically noted below. Task Number: 01 Task Title: Project Management Responsible Persons: Metro Task Manager: Ken Maynard DSA Task Manager: Don Stoughton Description of Work: DSA will act as the “Owners Representative” on behalf of Metro during the planning, design, and construction stages of the Criminal Justice Center renovation and construction project. Specifically, DSA will work with Metro, the architect and contractors as follows: Provide coordination between architect, contractors, and Metro user agencies and related project work efforts. « Provide project level review and consulting to ensure mission, schedule and technical compatibility between project components. « Provide high level schedule and technical coordination between the architect, contractors and Metro user agencies to ensure timely information and work product flow. « Provide monthly status reports with technical and financial summaries. Coordinate and make decisions on behalf of Metro during the planning, design and construction document stages of the Criminal Justice Center renovation and construction project. « Coordinate and make decisions on behalf of Metro during the construction period of the Criminal Justice Center renovation and construction project. Provide other related work as directed by the Metro Finance Director. Resource Requirements: See attached Labor Summary and Cost Tables Page 1 ARCHIVE
Cost: The following costs are estimated for performance of this Task Order. Labor 792 Hours 2, 3-Day Trips Each Travel Expenses Month Total Estimated Cost $146,520 Schedule: This Task will be performed over a 15-month period to coincide with the performance period of the construction and renovation of the Criminal Justice Center. Deliverable Items: The following deliverables will be prepared under this Task Order. Planned Title Description Delivery Number Month An overview of the Work 10 days performed during the month after the 01-4 thru 01-15, Monthly Report and planned work for the next end of month under each task and a each financial summary. month Status briefing of the Finance 2-times 01-1 thru 01-30 Briefing Director and the Metro Task each Manager month Warranties: None applicable. Licenses: None applicable. Special Terms & Conditions: None applicabie. Assumptions: None Other: Page 2 ARCHIVE

Task Number: 02 Task Title: General Consulting Responsible Persons: Metro Task Manager: Ken Maynard DSA Task Manager: Don Stoughton Description of Work: DSA wilt provide criminal justice and correctional management consulting and technical assistance to Metro during the period of this contract and shall act as the Metropolitan Governments representative on criminal justice and correctional matters as directed by the Metro Finance Director. Specifically, DSA will work with Metro and its agencies as follows: e DSA shall have oversight responsibility on behalf of the Finance Director, to evaluate and report to the Director or the Metro Task Manager on the timeliness, effectiveness, and efficiency of criminal justice plans and the program development and implementation of the principles and elements of the Criminal Justice Master Plan. e DSA shall provide professional and technical advice to the Finance Director regarding techniques, methods, plans, procedures, management practice, facility development programs, and plans for the necessary improvements in Metro jail operations. « During the period of this contract, DSA shall continue to advise the Finance Director and the Metro Task Manager, based on the review of correctional capital projects with emphasis on the operational planning necessary to implement such projects in an efficient and secure manner. DSA shall, on behaif of the Finance Director and within the scope of his employment, perform such other specific and special tasks as may be required and directed by the Finance Director.
